tickets.title: Prepare spring tuition funding schedule
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month schedule showing how much of Marzipan Meadow College charges can come from Elin's 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody, the $21,000 tuition set-aside at Teacup Comet Bank, and the $48,000 short-term Treasury fund at Paper Otter Custody without changing retirement contributions.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that schedule, dated December 19, 2023.

tickets.title: Obtain official Marzipan Meadow billing packet
tickets.text: Obtain the itemized student account PDF from Marzipan Meadow College to substantiate the payment plan and qualified expense categories, as the portal screenshot was missing this specific document.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to obtain the packet, dated December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Reconcile Velvet Acorn 529 balance discrepancy
tickets.text: Reconcile the balance discrepancy for Elin's 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody, which shows $67,400 on Mira's mobile screenshot versus $72,270 on the downloaded statement.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to reconcile the balance discrepancy, dated December 15, 2023.

tickets.title: Identify direct payment or reimbursement workflow
tickets.text: Identify an acceptable direct payment or reimbursement workflow for Elin's tuition at Marzipan Meadow College, as the college portal rejected the bank verification for direct 529 payment.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to identify the workflow, dated December 18, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan education funding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a separate planning track for Rowan's education funding using the existing 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody, expected test and application costs, and a first-year college savings target that does not rely on borrowing.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection, dated December 29, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare off-campus housing cost projection
tickets.text: Prepare a projection of which rent, food, and utility amounts for Elin's potential off-campus apartment could fit into the education funding plan versus parent cash flow.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection, dated January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare scholarship and aid cost-gap estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a cost-gap estimate for Rowan's college list before the first school deposit decision to compare merit aid offers consistently, using the scholarship response calendar provided by the counselor.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the estimate, dated February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare tax estimate and sale-sequencing review
tickets.text: Prepare a tax estimate and sale-sequencing review for the Paper Otter taxable account at Paper Otter Custody, noting unrealized gains in the equity index fund and the Treasury position earmarked for tuition.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the tax estimate and sale-sequencing review, dated January 3, 2024.
